# arifOS Observatory — Constitutional Governance Dashboard
# https://arifos.arif-fazil.com

> Constitutional governance observatory for the arifOS federation. Real-time organ health, floor scores, vault status, and federation topology.

## What This Is

arifOS is a constitutional AI governance framework. This observatory provides real-time visibility into:
- **7 Federation Organs**: arifOS (kernel), GEOX (earth), WEALTH (capital), WELL (vitality), AAA (A2A hub), A-FORGE (execution), VAULT999 (audit)
- **13 Constitutional Floors**: F1 AMANAH through F13 SOVEREIGN
- **VAULT999**: Immutable audit chain with hash-chained seals
- **888 JUDGE**: Constitutional verdict engine

## MCP Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/mcp` | POST | MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 (streamable-http) |
| `/health` | GET | Organ health status |
| `/tools.json` | GET | Available MCP tools |
| `/sse` | GET | Server-sent events (legacy) |
| `/api/status` | GET | Federation status |

## Agent Discovery

- Agent Card: `/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- MCP Manifest: `/.well-known/mcp.json`
- AI Plugin: `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`
- Federation Manifest: `/federation-manifest.json`

All operations governed by 13 constitutional floors (F1-F13). Irreversible actions require human sovereign approval (F13). DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Forged, Not Given.
